name: Code Review Checklist
description: A free-form markdown checklist for thorough, consistent code reviews
body:
# Code Review Checklist

Apply this checklist when reviewing a pull request. Be specific and reference exact files and line numbers.

## Correctness

- Does the change do what the PR description says?
- Are edge cases handled (empty input, nulls, large values, concurrency)?
- Are error paths handled and surfaced, not swallowed?

## Tests

- Is new behavior covered by tests? Do the tests actually assert the behavior?
- Do the tests fail without the change (no false-positive coverage)?

## Readability

- Do names describe intent? Is the control flow easy to follow?
- Is the new code consistent with the surrounding style and conventions?

## Security & Data

- Is user input validated and escaped?
- Are secrets, tokens, or PII kept out of logs and responses?

## Performance

- Any N+1 queries, unbounded loops, or needless allocations in hot paths?

## Before approving

- Leave actionable comments (what to change and why).
- Approve only when correctness and tests are satisfied.
